# 🩺 MediScan AI

AI-powered Chest X-Ray Pneumonia Detection System built with React, FastAPI and Deep Learning.

## 🚀 Live Demo

- **Frontend:** https://mediscanai-frontend.onrender.com
- **Backend:** https://mediscanai-bb2m.onrender.com

## ✨ Features

- Doctor Login
- Patient Details
- Chest X-Ray Upload
- AI Pneumonia Detection
- Confidence Score
- Heatmap Generation
- PDF Medical Report
- Doctor-wise Dashboard
- Scan History

## 🛠 Tech Stack

**Frontend:** React, Vite, React Router

**Backend:** FastAPI, Python, OpenCV, Pillow, ReportLab

**AI:** TensorFlow/Keras CNN

## ▶️ Run Locally

### Frontend

```bash
npm install
npm run dev
```

### Backend

```bash
cd backend
pip install -r requirements.txt
uvicorn main:app --reload
```
